facts: One oblique apparatus view: two side pulleys with axle projections; a cord runs from the left pulley to the central winding drum and onward to the right pulley.

Each pulley has two descending cord strands attached to a shallow circular weight/collar region and one lower narrow weight body. Left weight body is offset toward its right side; right weight body toward its left side in perspective.
One central winding drum has a crank above and a continuous vertical shaft below, including a small collar/coupling, entering the lid of one calorimeter.
The calorimeter has a cylindrical wall, oval lid/rim, a small unlabeled raised lid fitting, and rests on one perspective rectangular/slotted base.
